# Changes here are hard to undo, so a PR touching them needs the owner's `human-reviewed` label to merge
# (.github/workflows/human-review.yml). Everything else merges on green CI. One glob per line; ** spans folders.
# Add a path when a mistake there would lose players' data, slow every server, or let a change skip these checks.

# The checks themselves: a PR could otherwise switch off what reviews it.
.github/**

# Saved data formats: a wrong change here loses players' data on every server that updates.
api/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/api/data/**
common/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/common/economy/JsonEconomyProvider.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/Data*.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/WorldsLevelData.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/data/**

# Hot paths: these run millions of times a second, so a slow change slows every server.
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/block/LevelMixin.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/block/BlockStateBaseMixin.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/block/BoundTickingBlockEntityMixin.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/*/ServerLevelMixin.java
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/entity/EntityVelocityMixin.java

# Untrusted input: packets from clients, and the jars Hadron loads.
neoforge/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/neoforge/mixin/net/**
common/src/main/java/dev/iredsc/hadron/common/PluginLoader.java

# Public API signatures: uncomment at the first release, when plugins start depending on them.
